How to unlock:

1. Obtain Indian Ocean port permit
2. Speak to Port Official in any Capital City (Seville, Lisbon; non-player cities like Genoa and Stockholm also count) to view a cutscene
3. Go to Alexandria and speak to Ibn twice (he is south of Harbor port official)
4. Go and (in any order) talk twice with the following NPCs:

※Artisan looking man in Tunis, by the bank
※Young Merchant in Naples, close to the Gatekeeper
※Middle-aged Man in Cairo, next to the item shop

5. Talk to Ibn in Alexandria again, once.
6. Enter Sea of Wonders (blue cloud) northwest of Alexandria and locate/click star on each map three times to discover Lighthouse of Alexandria
7. Speak to Ibn to report discovery; recipe book unlocked.


ALTERNATIVE ROUTE:

Find a player who has done the above steps, and ask them to take you into Sea of Wonders. Complete steps 6 and 7 to permanently unlock access to book without having to do steps 3 through 5.
